title: Proper direct image preserves a universal finite-coefficient tensor unit
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings in Type(u+1), phi:A -> B a ring map, and p:X -> Y a proper scheme morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism]. In ordinary small-etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], let K be in D+(X,A), L in D+(X,B), and eta:K -> Res L exhibit L as derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], meaning that eta induces bijections Hom(L,N) -> Hom(K,Res N) for every ambient derived B-object N. Then Rp_A(eta) followed by the inverse of the canonical restriction/direct-image comparison [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons] exhibits Rp_B L as derived scalar extension of Rp_A K. This is the actual canonical D+ comparison, with its ambient universal property. No flatness, Tor-amplitude, constructibility, Noetherian or base quasi-compactness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the scalar adjunction to identify any ambient universal tensor arrow eta with the scalar unit followed by restriction of a unique B-linear isomorphism. Universal properties show this map is invertible.

Extend the existing scalar-mate projection calculation to all derived objects: its proof is ambient and does not use its two boundedness witnesses. The scalar/tensor pullback normalization and the two geometric counit-mate equations give U(scalarMate) followed by the restriction/direct-image mate as precisely the proper projection map conjugated by the scalar/tensor isomorphisms.

The reverse scalar/pullback mate is invertible. Taking the mate twice identifies the ambient restriction/direct-image comparison with its conjugate, so this direct-image comparison is invertible. Apply the finite-coefficient proper projection formula. Cancel the invertible direct-image comparison and reflect isomorphisms through exact restriction of scalars by the homology criterion. Thus the B-linear proper scalar mate is invertible without a Noetherian hypothesis.

The iterated-mate conjugation and unit equation identify the scalar unit followed by restriction of the proper scalar mate and the restriction/direct-image mate with direct image of the original scalar unit. Naturality transports the equation to eta. Therefore direct image of eta followed by the inverse restriction/direct-image mate is universal.

Reuse the proved restriction_plus_mate calculation in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteCoefficientDirectImage: the bounded-below direct-image comparison is exactly the ambient mate conjugated by the right-derived compatibility isomorphisms. That calculation derives the exact pullback mate and restricts the ambient adjunction through the fully faithful D+ inclusions. Transport the ambient universal arrow through these canonical isomorphisms; their naturality and inverse equations give exactly the displayed D+ arrow.
